purpose: Separate numerical replay tolerance, scientific evidence, transport diagnostics, and expiring-submission action value; then replay every canonical historical family and closed group without fitting a model or reading official inputs.

requirements: exact lineage, comparator, metric, row, key and ordering contract
no target, temporal, event, episode or official-interface leakage
candidate, population and action table frozen before outcome access
no result-driven retry, mutation or threshold search

numerical_replay.warning: Numerical tolerance is only a reproduction check. It is never an effect-size or promotion margin.

scientific_effect.normalized_benefit: positive is better: P1 candidate-incumbent F1; P2/P3 incumbent-candidate RMSE
scientific_effect.confidence_interval: paired dependence-preserving two-sided 90 percent interval, equivalent to one-sided alpha 0.05 directional checks
scientific_effect.exploratory_or_inconclusive: interval crosses 0, or a favorable point has no valid interval
scientific_effect.primary_harm: upper bound < 0, or overwhelming valid degradation on the pooled primary
scientific_effect.equivalence: allowed only when the entire interval lies inside a separately justified, pre-result SESOI band

dimensions: P1 month, station, layer and anomaly type
P2 historical window, season and layer
P3 forward window, station and lead
transport.hard_only_if: the official mixture, explicit safety objective, or quantified operational cost makes the slice a predeclared requirement

competition_action.candidate_value: probability of official improvement times expected leaderboard-point gain plus value of information minus the opportunity cost of the best alternative slot
competition_action.expiring_quota_rule: Near expiry, a valid nonduplicate candidate with positive expected action value or decision-changing information value may be probed even when local uncertainty crosses zero.
competition_action.three_daily_submissions: three correlated Public queries, not three independent confirmations
competition_action.portfolio_default: one exploit or frozen confirmation, one structurally orthogonal probe, and one reserve/replicate only when each has a predeclared result-to-action table

P1.paired_unit: joint KST-day blocks preserving complete events and station-layer observations
P1.objective_aligned_sanity: For a pure add-positive union on the same rows, proposal precision must exceed incumbent F1 divided by two. This is not a promotion delta.

P2.metric: pooled all-row temperature RMSE in Celsius
P2.paired_unit: contiguous KST-day blocks preserving layers 2-4 together

P3.metric: pooled all-row six-lead significant-wave-height RMSE in meters
P3.paired_unit: storm episode where available, otherwise window-stratified contiguous anchor-day blocks with all six leads intact

P1-F02.reason: Positive pooled F1 with an interval crossing zero was rejected by an unsupported worst-slice veto.

P1-F15.reason: Positive pooled micro-F1 with an interval crossing zero was rejected by an unsupported worst-group veto.

P1-F16.reason: Positive weighted aggregate and a negative G-ORS slice coexist inside an interval crossing zero; neither benefit nor harm is established.

P2-F10.reason: The confirmation interval crosses zero; the exact universal penalty may stay closed, but population harm is not established.

P3-F05.reason: The exact KMA deployment is unresolved; the broader KMA information axis is demonstrably not closed.

P3-F06.reason: The outer analog interval crosses zero; the exact chain remains closed to same-surface retuning.

P3-F09.reason: The pooled direction is favorable and the legacy interval crosses zero; failure of a 0.005m magnitude gate is not scientific harm.

outlier_policy.allowed: predeclared diagnostic flags, robust loss, bounded correction or abstention
outlier_policy.hard_delete_requires: independently validated sensor-error label/rule plus a frozen estimand and evaluation contract
outlier_policy.inherited_comparator_extreme_with_exact_: preserve the row and record the inherited condition
